claim_mappings.artifact_section: final.md §1 Recommendation and scope; criticism-dispositions.md F5
claim_mappings.claim: The cache is a private user-agent cache; its first release is deliberately limited to complete 200 GET responses and uses 304 only to validate a stored representation.
claim_mappings.source_version: RFC 9111 (June 2022); exact retrieved text body pinned by SHA-256
claim_mappings.governing_scope: RFC cache storage/validation rules generally; 200-GET-only status profile is a narrower product choice.
claim_mappings.unresolved_uncertainty: No implementation or library status table has been audited.

claim_mappings.artifact_section: final.md §2 Ownership, keys, and storage; criticism-dispositions.md F1 and F5
claim_mappings.claim: Private allows a private cache to store subject to other requirements; shared-cache authorization restrictions do not themselves establish account isolation or sign-out behavior.
claim_mappings.source_version: RFC 9111 (June 2022); exact retrieved text body pinned by SHA-256
claim_mappings.governing_scope: §3.5's Authorization restrictions are specifically for shared caches; §5.2.2.7 distinguishes private and shared storage.
claim_mappings.unresolved_uncertainty: Account partitions, credential fingerprints, key protection, and sign-out cleanup are application policy and have not been implemented or tested.

claim_mappings.claim: Storage must satisfy response/header-field rules and update stored metadata atomically enough to avoid inconsistent representation state.
claim_mappings.source_version: RFC 9111 (June 2022); exact retrieved text body pinned by SHA-256
claim_mappings.governing_scope: HTTP cache header storage/update behavior; atomic manifest generations, LRU, and quotas are product persistence policy.
claim_mappings.unresolved_uncertainty: Disk format, crash recovery, corruption handling, and candidate quotas have not been implemented or measured.

claim_mappings.artifact_section: final.md §2 Partition and variant selection; criticism-dispositions.md F2
claim_mappings.claim: Vary field matching permits only specified semantic transformations, preserves absent-field distinctions, and a member * always fails to match.
claim_mappings.source_version: RFC 9111 (June 2022); exact retrieved text body pinned by SHA-256
claim_mappings.governing_scope: Stored response selection by nominated request fields in a private or shared cache.
claim_mappings.unresolved_uncertainty: Sensitive-field matching and changed-Vary handling need tests in the chosen storage/client integration.

claim_mappings.artifact_section: final.md §3 Cache eligibility and directive policy; criticism-dispositions.md F1
claim_mappings.claim: Request/response no-cache, request/response no-store, must-understand, must-revalidate, and private have distinct storage/reuse effects and scope.
claim_mappings.source_version: RFC 9111 (June 2022); exact retrieved text body pinned by SHA-256
claim_mappings.governing_scope: Directive requirements and the must-understand/no-store status condition; qualified no-cache simplification is declared product policy.
claim_mappings.unresolved_uncertainty: Fixture verification must establish that the named 200 storage and 304-update paths fully implement status-specific caching behavior before taking the must-understand/no-store exception.

claim_mappings.artifact_section: final.md §3 Freshness and age; criticism-dispositions.md F2
claim_mappings.claim: Freshness lifetime uses shared s-maxage only for shared caches, max-age before Expires, and current age includes apparent age, response delay, and residence time.
claim_mappings.source_version: RFC 9111 (June 2022); exact retrieved text body pinned by SHA-256
claim_mappings.governing_scope: Freshness and Age calculation by HTTP caches; no-heuristic freshness and fail-closed clock policy are narrower product choices.
claim_mappings.unresolved_uncertainty: Clock continuity and date parsing behavior after restart have not been tested.

claim_mappings.claim: A received response without Date is timestamped at receipt; Date semantics and cache handling are defined by HTTP.
claim_mappings.source_version: RFC 9110 (June 2022); exact retrieved text body pinned by SHA-256
claim_mappings.governing_scope: HTTP Date generation and recipient handling.
claim_mappings.unresolved_uncertainty: No live server or clock test was run.

claim_mappings.artifact_section: final.md §§3 and 5 stale/offline behavior; criticism-dispositions.md F3
claim_mappings.claim: Stale responses are prohibited by directives such as no-cache and must-revalidate; absent a prohibition they require disconnection or explicit permission, and must-revalidate requires an error while disconnected.
claim_mappings.source_version: RFC 9111 (June 2022); exact retrieved text body pinned by SHA-256
claim_mappings.governing_scope: Stale response generation by caches; UI confirmation and network-state handling are application policy.
claim_mappings.unresolved_uncertainty: No offline or 504 integration behavior was executed.

claim_mappings.artifact_section: final.md §4 Revalidation and 304 handling; criticism-dispositions.md F4
claim_mappings.claim: Conditional requests use stored validators; If-None-Match takes precedence and uses weak comparison for validation; Last-Modified is an alternative.
claim_mappings.source_version: RFC 9111 (June 2022); exact retrieved text body pinned by SHA-256
claim_mappings.unresolved_uncertainty: No client-generated conditional request was captured or tested.

claim_mappings.artifact_section: final.md §4 Revalidation and 304 handling; criticism-dispositions.md F4
claim_mappings.claim: If-None-Match uses weak comparison for recipient validation; If-Modified-Since is ignored when If-None-Match is present.
claim_mappings.source_version: RFC 9110 (June 2022); exact retrieved text body pinned by SHA-256
claim_mappings.governing_scope: HTTP conditional request and validator semantics.
claim_mappings.unresolved_uncertainty: Validator interoperation with an eventual library/server remains untested.

claim_mappings.artifact_section: final.md §4 Revalidation and 304 handling; criticism-dispositions.md F4
claim_mappings.claim: 304 has no representation content/trailers, carries metadata needed for cache updates, and must be matched to eligible stored responses before header updates.
claim_mappings.source_version: RFC 9111 (June 2022); exact retrieved text body pinned by SHA-256
claim_mappings.governing_scope: HTTP cache response update and validation behavior; the 200-GET profile is a product restriction.
claim_mappings.unresolved_uncertainty: 304 with changed Vary, altered representation metadata, and multiple matching entries requires fixture verification.

claim_mappings.artifact_section: final.md §4 Revalidation and 304 handling; criticism-dispositions.md F4
claim_mappings.claim: A 304 is intended for reuse of an existing selected representation and cannot contain content or trailers; expected cache-relevant response fields include Date, ETag, Vary, Cache-Control, and Expires.
claim_mappings.source_version: RFC 9110 (June 2022); exact retrieved text body pinned by SHA-256
claim_mappings.governing_scope: HTTP server generation and meaning of a 304 response.

claim_mappings.claim: The mature-library/custom-cache choice and narrowed support profile are product engineering decisions constrained by the RFC obligations above.
claim_mappings.governing_scope: Product architecture; no particular library behavior is asserted.
claim_mappings.unresolved_uncertainty: No library/version was researched or selected.

claim_mappings.claim: The 512 MiB, 10,000-entry, and 64 MiB starter limits are proposed defaults, not measured source facts.
claim_mappings.unresolved_uncertainty: Tune after representative corpus and device-storage measurement.

claim_mappings.artifact_section: final.md §6 Alternatives and non-cached requests; criticism-dispositions.md F5
claim_mappings.claim: An earlier URL-only cache was rejected because it conflated accounts and variants.
claim_mappings.governing_scope: Supplied design history, not a protocol claim.
claim_mappings.unresolved_uncertainty: Only the history recorded in the supplied draft is represented.

unresolved_uncertainty: No independent live errata lookup was performed; the reviewed body is pinned by its exact SHA-256 and public RFC Editor URL.
No HTTP implementation, library/version, fixture replay, benchmark, deployment, or real network/offline behavior was tested.

The must-understand exception is gated on fixture evidence; sensitive Vary-field fingerprinting, clock behavior across process restart, and changed-Vary 304 handling remain implementation decisions and validation gates.
The proposed cache quotas are unmeasured starting values.
The native Goal receipt identifies its thread and active objective but does not expose service tier; actual tier remains unknown.
